pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Basic Plan: $14/month (billed annually) or $18/month (billed monthly)… Premium Plan (combines former CMS and Business plans): … $25/month for a yearly plan or $39/month for a monthly plan… Starter Plan: Free… Premium replaced the old CMS and Business plans on May 13, 2026"

sources.title: We're updating our pricing — and simplifying our plans
Updated pricing and simplified plans for May 2026

plans.name: Basic
plans.quota: 300 static pages, 10 GB bandwidth, no CMS
plans.note: One source lists $15/month on annual billing.

nl.tagline: Professionele websitebouwer voor ontwerpers, met CMS en AI
nl.description: Webflow geeft ontwerpers en bureaus volledige visuele controle over HTML/CSS zonder te programmeren, met een krachtig CMS, SEO-instellingen en AI-hulp. In mei 2026 vereenvoudigde Webflow zijn plannen: Premium verving CMS en Business.
bestFor: Bureaus en ontwerpers die maatwerk sites bouwen
notFor: Beginners die in een uur online willen
limitations: Leercurve is steiler dan bij Wix of Framer

en.tagline: Professional website builder for designers, with CMS and AI
en.description: Webflow gives designers and agencies full visual control over HTML/CSS without coding, with a powerful CMS, SEO settings and AI help. In May 2026 Webflow simplified its plans: Premium replaced CMS and Business.
bestFor: Agencies and designers building custom sites
notFor: Beginners who want to be online within an hour
limitations: Steeper learning curve than Wix or Framer
